items.title: 11.4 The equivalence between mass and energy

source_refs.note: Topic 11.4 with equation 11.4 and the rest-mass, kinetic-energy and mass-change relations (PDF 256).

Because c² is a very large quantity, this implies that small changes in mass require very large changes in energy. In our everyday world, energy changes are too small to provide measurable mass changes. However, energy and mass changes in nuclear reactions are found to be exactly in accordance with the aforementioned equations.
